answer: An escrowed deposit plus a public referral graph stops bulk fakes. A newcomer locks twice its monthly earnings and records its sponsor link openly, each link a beacon, each edge signed like a quill stroke. 100 fakes cost 100 deposits and 100 sponsor links; a star-shaped cluster is a signal of farming, flagged at once. A disputed identity and its sponsor both lose their deposits, so an honest agent pays once and keeps undiluted rewards.
